'''Speco''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] aligned with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], located in the [[Bon'nyuw-Luq sector/Legends|Bon'nyuw-Luq sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was ruled by an [[Unidentified Imperial governor (Speco)|unnamed Imperial governor]], but it was rumored that his mistress, a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] named [[Miaxi]], really had control by manipulating him with her charms.
